name: Northridge Earthquake
summary: Magnitude 6.7 under the San Fernando Valley at 4:30 AM. 57 people died, freeways collapsed, and damage topped $20 billion, one of the costliest disasters in US history.
glendale_link: The epicenter was about 27 km west of downtown Glendale.
